description: Illustrative Galaxium heliosphere model recovered by Galaxio from its shipped constructor; this is not a measured heliopause boundary.

sourceReference.rendering: Unlit FrontSide with normal alpha blending; depth test enabled and depth write disabled.

approximation.geometry: Same Float32-rounded analytic deformation at half the angular sampling on each axis.
approximation.normal: Original per-vertex radial normals remain in the numeric mesh. Rendering samples one unit radial normal at each face center, separately from its geometric culling normal.
approximation.material: 128 uniformly spaced facing samples in [0,1], nearest sample selected per face. Both linear RGB times rim and opacity times rim are baked; distance fade remains a shared scalar.
approximation.coverage: Each actual a,b,c triangle uses a prepared PolyCSS projective parallelogram a,b,b+c-a,c with transparent PNG coverage outside u+v<=1; no runtime clipping or mesh construction.
